votes.evidence: At bc7090d, stringifyReport (src/report/index.ts:133-136) runs JSON.stringify and then rewrites only '##['. Nothing replaces C1 or Cf characters. The JSON stays valid if they are escaped as \uXXXX, and the parsed value is the same. I re-ran it with a stdio fixture: serverInfo.name 'srv\u009B31mRED\u0085x' and a tool named 'get\u009B2Jx‮txt'. In --format json stdout I counted U+009B 13 times, U+202E 12 times and U+0085 once, all raw. In --format sarif: U+009B 20 times and U+202E 20 times. The text, markdown and junit outputs had 0 of each. This is not covered by round-3 A07-05/A07-07, which fixed annotations and the text report only. Severity is low: few terminals honour 8-bit C1 in UTF-8, but bidi reordering in a CI log is a real visual spoof.
